arguments.content:
-- Migration: add reward_band to customers and backfill it from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv: A -> gold, B -> silver, C -> bronze.

-- 1) Add the new loyalty column.
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN reward_band TEXT;

-- 2) Backfill reward_band from legacy_code using the codes.csv mapping.
UPDATE customers
SET reward_band = CASE legacy_code
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
  END
WHERE legacy_code IS NOT NULL;
